message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV/JSON files and evaluates string fields with eval() without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote source fetching and therefore no checksum verification or source authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The dataset loading code simply reads CSV/JSON files and evaluates label fields with eval() without any validation of label values against an expected set or distribution comparison.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering is performed on training samples during data preparation; data is loaded directly from files without defensive checks.

No detected model integrity verification: Model weights are loaded via `self.model.load_state_dict(self.training_model.state_dict())` and from checkpoint folders without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets and initializes iterators but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation enforcement of the test set from training data, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics; results are simply written to a text file.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path in SupervisedTestingFunc and init_dataset reads data directly from CSV/files and passes it to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from tester.test() are passed directly to str() and written to file with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation of any kind.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM text-in/text-out pipeline; it appears to be a medical coding/classification model, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
